datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2019 across Haiti. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing food insecurity conditions at multiple time points, enabling temporal tracking of acute food insecurity impacts.
